# Colour profiles

These are third-party ICC profiles, kept unmodified; `SHA256SUMS` records their
contents. Each profile carries its owner's copyright notice inside it.

The profiles listed in `SHIP` are the ones whose terms allow redistribution: the
22 Adobe bundle profiles, the IDEAlliance SWOP 2006 profile, Heidelberg's ISO
Coated v2 and sRGB. They are copied into every release archive, Docker image and
npm package next to Kura's own profiles, with `LICENSES/`. Profiles without a
distribution grant are not shipped; where Kura regenerates an identical profile
itself (see below) it ships its own copy, and the rest are still used when they
are installed on the user's computer.

| Profiles | Owner | Terms |
|---|---|---|
| Adobe bundle profiles (22): AdobeRGB1998, AppleRGB, ColorMatchRGB, PAL_SECAM, SMPTE-C, VideoHD, VideoNTSC, VideoPAL, CoatedFOGRA27, CoatedFOGRA39, CoatedGRACoL2006, JapanColor2001Coated, JapanColor2001Uncoated, JapanColor2002Newspaper, JapanColor2003WebCoated, JapanWebCoated, UncoatedFOGRA29, USWebCoatedSWOP, USWebUncoated, WebCoatedFOGRA28, WebCoatedSWOP2006Grade3, WebCoatedSWOP2006Grade5 | Adobe Systems Incorporated | Distributed under Adobe's Color Profile Bundling License. End-user terms: `LICENSES/ICC-PROFILE-TERMS.md`; Adobe's documents: `LICENSES/adobe/` |
| Other Adobe profiles (19): BlackWhite, CIERGB, DotGain10/20/25/30, Dot_Gain_15_prct, EuropeISOCoatedFOGRA27, EuroscaleCoated, EuroscaleUncoated, Flat_XYZ, Gamma1_8, Gamma2_2, JapanStandard, LAB_D50, NewsprintIFRA26, PCS_XYZ, USNewsprintSNAP2007, USSheetfedCoated, USSheetfedUncoated, WideGamutRGB | Adobe Systems Incorporated | Not part of Adobe's bundling download, so not covered by the bundling licence. Eleven of them (BlackWhite, DotGain10/15/20/25/30, Gamma1_8, Gamma2_2, LAB_D50, PCS_XYZ, Flat_XYZ) are regenerated by Kura itself from published formulas into `pdfa-engine/core/icc/` by `pdfa-engine/scripts/gen_icc.py`; those regenerated copies are what Kura ships |
| `SWOP2006_Coated3v2.icc` | X-Rite, made available by IDEAlliance | May be used, embedded, exchanged and shared without restriction; may not be altered or sold without written permission of IDEAlliance (notice inside the profile) |
| `ISOcoated_v2_eci.icc` | Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG | Heidelberg's licence for generic profiles of standard printing conditions: free distribution, no fee may be charged |
| `PSOcoated_v3.icc` | ECI European Color Initiative / Heidelberg | Distribution requires written permission of ECI |
| `DefaultCMYK.icc` | Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG | All rights reserved; no distribution grant |
| `ProPhoto.icm` | Eastman Kodak Company | All rights reserved; no distribution grant. Kura regenerates its own ProPhoto RGB from the published ROMM RGB definition into `pdfa-engine/core/icc/` and ships that |
| `sRGB_IEC61966-2.1.icc` | Hewlett-Packard Company | Copyright notice only |
